AVControl.Panel.Title: AV Control
AVControl.Panel.Hint: Open the GM control panel for AV Control.
AVControl.Panel.Placeholder: Scene switching, follow camera, Audio and Encounter automation are not active.
AVControl.Display.Title: Shared display
AVControl.Display.Unavailable: Saved account is unavailable — select another account or clear it
AVControl.Display.Hint: Use a dedicated non-GM player account in one browser session. Save the selection before testing. This does not change scenes or permissions.
AVControl.Display.Status.notReady: Waiting for Foundry to finish loading.
AVControl.Display.Status.unavailable: The saved account was removed, banned or made a GM. Select another account or clear the selection.
AVControl.Display.Status.untested: The account is online. Its AV Control connection has not been tested.
AVControl.Display.Status.checking: Checking the saved display account (up to 5 seconds)…
AVControl.Display.Status.responded: The selected display client responded. Last connection test succeeded.
AVControl.Display.Status.noResponse: No valid response. Check that AV Control is loaded on the display client, reload it, and try again.
AVControl.Display.Error.Permission: Only a GM can configure or test the display.
AVControl.Display.Error.NotReady: Wait for Foundry to finish loading.
AVControl.Display.Error.Selection: Choose an existing non-GM player account, or clear the selection.
AVControl.Display.Error.Save: The display account could not be saved. Check your permissions and connection.
AVControl.View.Title: Screen and shared vision
AVControl.View.Hint: Show screen restores the last shared vision, or normal player view if none was configured. Shared vision requires the same single-level scene on both clients, Token Vision enabled, and Owner permission for the display account on the chosen actors. Permissions and fog settings are never changed automatically.
AVControl.View.NoTokens: No visible player-owned tokens with enabled vision in this scene.
AVControl.View.Result.idle: No screen command sent from this panel yet.
AVControl.View.Result.sending: Saving request and waiting for the display…
AVControl.View.Result.savedOffline: Request saved. The offline display will apply it when it connects.
AVControl.View.Result.pending: Request saved, but not confirmed by the display. Check screen status again.
AVControl.View.Result.shown: ✓ Display confirmed: normal player view restored.
AVControl.View.Result.shared: ✓ Display confirmed: shared token vision applied.
AVControl.View.Error.InvalidState: Choose at least one valid token before applying shared vision.
AVControl.View.Error.Account: Save a valid non-GM display account first. Checking status also requires it to be online.
AVControl.View.Error.Scene: The display is not ready on the same scene as the GM. It remains black until the requested scene is ready.
AVControl.View.Error.Vision: Shared vision requires Token Vision enabled on the scene. The display remains black.
AVControl.View.Error.Levels: Shared vision currently supports single-level scenes only. The display remains black.
AVControl.View.Error.Tokens: One or more selected tokens are missing, hidden, not player-owned or have no vision. The display remains black if the request was received.
AVControl.View.Error.Ownership: The display account needs Owner permission on every selected actor. Configure permissions manually, then reapply. The display remains black.
AVControl.View.Error.Apply: The display could not apply the request and remains black.
AVControl.View.Error.Send: Display confirmation failed. Check the display connection and screen status; the request may already have been applied.
